description: Header file defining the ExceptionHandler class for Windows crash minidump handling in Google Breakpad, including callback types, class interface, and internal mechanisms.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Manages crash dump creation and handling for Windows applications, including setting up exception filters, callbacks, and dump writing.

classes.name: AppMemory
classes.description: Represents a memory region to include in a minidump.

methods.name: WriteMinidump
methods.description: Creates a minidump of the current process.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpForException
methods.description: Creates a minidump for a specific exception.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpForChild
methods.description: Creates a minidump of a child process.

methods.name: RequestUpload
methods.description: Requests upload of a crash report.

methods.name: RegisterAppMemory
methods.description: Registers a memory region to include in dumps.

methods.name: UnregisterAppMemory
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered memory region.
